entities.name: Yellow River (Huang He) Basin
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The basin of China's second-longest river, called "the Cradle of Chinese Civilization." The fertile loess plains of the Yellow River supported the earliest Chinese agricultural settlements, Shang dynasty capitals, and the development of Chinese writing, bronze technology, and political philosophy that would shape East Asian civilization for millennia.
